title: Acyclicity of simplicial presheaves satisfying the hypercovering conditions
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file hypercovering.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: Prove H_i(K) = 0 for i > 0 and H_0(K) = Z_G^# for a simplicial presheaf augmented to G satisfying the sheafified hypercovering conditions: build the coskeleton tower K -> ... -> K^n -> ... -> K^1 -> K^0 where K^n = cosk_n sk_n K and K^0 is the Cech nerve of K_0 over G, with the maps from universal properties and K^1 -> K^0 canonical; lemma-compare-cosk0 computes H_*(K^0); each transition K^n -> K^{n-1} is an isomorphism below degree n and, using (K^n)_n = K_n and (K^{n-1})_n = (cosk_{n-1} sk_{n-1} K)_n plus assumption (3), is sheaf-surjective in degree n, so lemma-acyclicity gives H_i(K^n) = H_i(K^{n-1}); descend the computation down the tower.
